title: PipRow's empty and capacity pips draw at 2.1:1 and 1.25:1 - the Ghost defect again
body:
## Summary
PipRow's `hollow` pip (border-white/25) and its capacity pip (border-white/[0.10]) are below the 3:1 non-text floor on #080a10; the capacity pip is effectively invisible.

## Description
PipRow.tsx:33 `hollow: border border-white/25` = 2.14:1; PipRow.tsx:41 `CAPACITY = border border-white/[0.10]` = 1.25:1. Ghost.tsx:64-73 records this repo's own lesson - an outline at ~0.12 alpha 'is not a dashed outline - it is nothing', caught only by photographing the screen. PipRow's capacity is the README's headline use ('`max` is exactly the capacity read that paragraph is reaching for', README.md:91-92) and it is the faintest mark in the vocabulary. Live: app/board/parts.tsx:119 Confidence draws `max={3}` (low = 1 amber pip + 2 invisible slots, so the 'of 3' scale is lost); app/playground/triage/Strengths.tsx:298,411 `max={MIN_N}` (shows n pips and no target); app/playground/hunt/Inspector.tsx:387 a row that is ALL hollow ('0 of N prerequisites') renders at 2.14:1; app/calendar/ChannelsTab.tsx:105 missing credentials are hollow.

## Flow
- Board: a 'low' confidence card shows one amber dot; the two capacity pips that make it read as '1 of 3' are 1.25:1.
- Sound lab Inspector: '0 of N prerequisites in place' renders as a row of near-invisible rings.
- Screen readers are fine (role=img + aria-label) - only the sighted reading breaks, exactly the Ghost case.

## Expected impact
Capacity and empty slots become visible, so every PipRow reads as 'k of n' on sight.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - an unfilled pip and a capacity pip are both visible on ink
Before: hollow 2.14:1, capacity 1.25:1 (white alpha over #080a10; WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1). 8 PipRow call sites; 3 use max, 4 draw hollow.
After: hollow border-white/55 (6.26:1), capacity border-white/35 (3.14:1) - both >= 3:1 and the 'capacity is fainter than hollow' ordering (PipRow.tsx:38-40) is preserved.
Method: probe - WCAG relative-luminance ratio of white at the class alpha composited over INK (tokens.ts:105)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: components/ui/signal/PipRow.tsx:33 (border-white/25), :41 (border-white/[0.10]), :38-40 (ordering contract); components/ui/signal/Ghost.tsx:64-73 (the measured precedent); components/ui/signal/README.md:91-92; call sites app/board/parts.tsx:119, app/playground/triage/Strengths.tsx:298,411, app/playground/hunt/Inspector.tsx:387, app/calendar/ChannelsTab.tsx:105, app/_phases/research/beats/BeatVariantBoard.tsx:92, app/_phases/research/beats/SlotColumn.tsx:48, app/playground/hunt/index.tsx:306
verify: Write tests/golden-path/pip-contrast.probe.spec.ts first: read PipRow.tsx (stripComments), extract the alpha from PIP.hollow and CAPACITY (`border-white/NN` or `/[0.NN]`), compute WCAG contrast of white at that alpha over #080a10, assert both >= 3 and hollow alpha > capacity alpha. Red on HEAD (2.14, 1.25), green after. Then photograph /board (cx-capture) and look at a low-confidence card.

title: Tapping or clicking a Hint closes it: hover/focus open it first, click toggles
body:
## Summary
Hint opens on mouseenter and focus, and its click handler is `toggle`; on a tap or click those open events fire first, so click finds `open === true` and closes it. A touch user never sees the disclosure.

## Description
Hint.tsx:135-137 rootProps open on onMouseEnter/onFocus; Hint.tsx:258 `onClick={d.toggle}`; toggle = `open ? hide() : show()` (l.117). The header promises the opposite: 'Opens on hover, on focus, and on click/tap (so a touch device and a keyboard reach the same content a mouse does)' (l.39-40). Measured in Playwright Chromium (Pixel 7 emulation, `page.tap`) and desktop `page.click`: the event order is mouseover -> focus -> click in both, and a mirror of Hint's handlers (state committed between discrete events, as React does) ends `open = false`. TabRail's locked-tab reason uses the same useHint (TabRail.tsx:191), as do Keycaps (15 sites) and StaleBadge `why`. 45 <Hint> sites + 15 <Keycaps> + 4 <StaleBadge> in app/.

## Flow
- Phone: tap the (i) glyph -> mouseover opens, focus re-opens, click toggles closed -> nothing visible (at most a flash).
- Desktop: hover shows the popover; clicking the glyph (the natural 'pin it' gesture) hides it.
- Keyboard: focus opens; Enter closes - tolerable, but the same toggle.

## Expected impact
The disclosure every replaced paragraph now lives behind becomes reachable on touch; restores the header's stated contract.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a tap on a Hint glyph leaves its disclosure open
Before: Chromium tap: events ['mouseover->show','focus->show','click->toggle (open was true)'], final open=false; desktop click identical. 0 of 2 pointer paths end open.
After: Click only closes a popover that a click opened - e.g. a ref recording `openedBy: 'hover'|'focus'|'click'`; a click on a passively-opened popover pins it instead - expected 2 of 2 end open; Escape, outside pointerdown and blur still close.
Method: experiment - Playwright Chromium (node_modules/playwright, chromium-1243) event-order run with a handler mirror; the React re-render between events is the modelled part (the in-repo probe lane cannot render Hint)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: components/ui/signal/Hint.tsx:39-40 (contract), :117 (toggle), :133-147 (rootProps open on hover/focus), :258 (onClick toggle); components/ui/signal/TabRail.tsx:191 (shared useHint); scratch run output: touch(Pixel 7) [mouseover->show, focus->show, click->toggle (open was true)] final open = false; mouse(desktop) same; consumers: 45 <Hint>, 15 <Keycaps>, 4 <StaleBadge>
verify: Needs a real-browser instrument (the npm test lane has no DOM): mount a page with a <Hint> (the /kit specimen, or any studio screen under NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH=1 dev), Playwright `page.tap` with Pixel 7 emulation on the glyph, assert the role=tooltip span is not `sr-only` 300ms later - red on HEAD. Repeat with `page.click` on desktop. Then confirm Escape, outside pointerdown and blur still close, and that a TabRail locked tab still discloses on focus.

title: BandTrack: the measured band (1.75:1) is fainter than the stand-in hatch (3.4:1)
body:
## Summary
BandTrack's real, measured band is drawn weaker than the hatched stand-in that exists to say 'nothing measured this' - the honesty mark out-shouts the measurement - and the band bounds are 3.14:1 text.

## Description
BandTrack.tsx:87: measured band `bg-cyan-400/25` = 1.75:1 against its own track (`bg-white/8`, l.82), under the 3:1 non-text floor; hatched band `text-cyan-300/45` stripes = 3.39:1. The header (l.24-27) says a hatched band 'must not read as a measurement' - today it reads as MORE of one. Bounds text at l.107 `text-white/35` = 3.14:1 (text floor 4.5:1); those two numbers are the window itself, i.e. the work. Consumers: app/_projects/wizard/stages.tsx:320 (no band) and :337 (band, hatched only for trailers - so every non-trailer template shows the faint measured band).

## Flow
- Create wizard, a non-trailer template with a runtime band: the band is barely distinguishable from the track; only the thumb reads.
- Trailer template: the stand-in hatch is clearly visible - the inversion the component was built to prevent.

## Expected impact
The window a target runtime should sit inside becomes visible, and 'measured' outranks 'stand-in' as designed.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the measured band is at least as visible as the stand-in band
Before: measured band 1.75:1 vs track; hatched 3.39:1; bounds text 3.14:1 (Tailwind cyan-400 #22d3ee / cyan-300 #67e8f9 approximated in sRGB over white/8 over #080a10).
After: band `bg-cyan-400/50` = 3.28:1 vs track with thumbs still 3.52:1 (cyan) / 3.54:1 (amber) against the band; bounds `text-white/55` = 6.26:1.
Method: probe - WCAG ratio computation of the composited colours
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: components/ui/signal/BandTrack.tsx:24-27 (stand-in must not read as measurement), :82 (track bg-white/8), :86-88 (bg-cyan-400/25 vs text-cyan-300/45 hatch), :99 (thumb), :107 (bounds text-white/35); app/_projects/wizard/stages.tsx:320,337-347
verify: Write tests/golden-path/bandtrack-contrast.probe.spec.ts first: stripComments(BandTrack.tsx); extract the measured-band alpha (`bg-cyan-400/NN`) and bounds alpha (`text-white/NN`); compute band-vs-track (#22d3ee at NN over white/8 over #080a10) >= 3 and bounds >= 4.5. Red on HEAD (1.75, 3.14). Then cx-capture a wizard-* screen at 1920 and look at the runtime rail.

title: Tally and Provenance chip keys render at 2.9:1 and 2.6:1 - the house chip's label
body:
## Summary
The visible key of the house chip (`KEPT` in `KEPT 12/36`, `MODEL` in a Provenance chip) multiplies an opacity onto an already-dimmed tone and lands under the 4.5:1 text floor.

## Description
Tally.tsx:98 `uppercase opacity-55` inside TALLY_TONE.neutral `text-white/60` (l.43) = effective 0.33 = 2.91:1. Provenance.tsx:57 `uppercase opacity-50` inside the same neutral tone = 0.30 = 2.59:1. The key is `aria-hidden` (sr text carries it), so this is purely the sighted reading - and on a Provenance chip the key is the only thing saying which verbatim value is the model and which is the run. CHIP_CLASS is 'the one chip spelling' (Tally.tsx:34-40), so the defect is the house look: 76 labelled <Tally> sites + 5 <Provenance> sites in app/.

## Flow
- Any TabRail tab with `tally.label`, any `<Tally label=...>` in a neutral tone: the key reads at 2.91:1.
- Asset provenance chips: MODEL / RUN / STEP / VENDOR / COST at 2.59:1 beside values at 0.85.

## Expected impact
Every labelled chip in the app becomes readable at AA without changing the chip's hierarchy (key still dimmer than value).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a chip's key is readable on ink
Before: Tally neutral key 2.91:1 (0.60 x 0.55), Provenance key 2.59:1 (0.60 x 0.50); 81 consumer sites.
After: key `opacity-80` in both: 0.48 effective = 4.98:1; value stays brighter (Tally numerals 0.60 = 7.30:1; Provenance value 0.85).
Method: probe - WCAG ratio of white at the composited alpha over #080a10 (the chip's bg-white/[0.04] moves it by < 0.1)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: components/ui/signal/Tally.tsx:39-48 (CHIP_CLASS, TALLY_TONE.neutral text-white/60), :98 (opacity-55); components/ui/signal/Provenance.tsx:56-58 (opacity-50 inside TALLY_TONE.neutral); grep counts: `<Tally[^>]*label=` 76, `<Provenance` 5
verify: Write tests/golden-path/chip-key-contrast.probe.spec.ts first: stripComments(Tally.tsx, Provenance.tsx); read TALLY_TONE.neutral's `text-white/NN` and each key span's `opacity-NN`; assert (NN/100 x opacity) composited white over #080a10 >= 4.5. Red on HEAD (2.91, 2.59), green after. The Almanac branch (k-tally) is untouched.

title: UpstreamBreak: done/idle step names at 3.1:1, 'not started' ring at 1.8:1
body:
## Summary
In the chain UpstreamBreak draws, every step name other than the blocked and current one is 3.14:1 text, and the 'not started' marker is a 1.77:1 ring - the filled/hollow distinction the component exists to draw is faint exactly where it matters.

## Description
UpstreamBreak.tsx:138 non-current names `text-white/35` = 3.14:1 (text floor 4.5:1) - this includes the DONE steps, i.e. what the user already has. UpstreamBreak.tsx:126 not-started `border border-white/20` = 1.77:1 (non-text floor 3:1), beside the done dot `bg-cyan-300/70` (l.124). The header (l.30-34) defines the picture as filled vs hollow vs ring; README.md:164-166 repeats it. The sr-only text (l.145-147) carries state for screen readers, so this is the sighted half. 11 consumer sites (it replaced four 40-60 word paragraphs, README.md:151-155).

## Flow
- Score step blocked at frames: 'Research' and 'Script' (done) and 'Cut' (not started) all render at 3.14:1; Cut's hollow ring at 1.77:1 is nearly invisible next to the cyan done dots.
- The reader cannot tell 'done' from 'not started' except by a low-contrast dot.

## Expected impact
The drawn chain - the replacement for four paragraphs - reads at a glance: names at AA, not-started visible as a ring.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every step name and marker in the chain is legible
Before: names 3.14:1 (white/35), not-started ring 1.77:1 (white/20) over #080a10; 11 consumers.
After: names `text-white/55` = 6.26:1 (still under the current step's /85, so 'you are here' keeps its rank); ring `border-white/45` = 4.50:1.
Method: probe - WCAG ratio of white at the class alpha over #080a10
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: components/ui/signal/UpstreamBreak.tsx:30-34 (picture contract), :124 (done dot), :126 (border-white/20), :131-139 (names text-white/35, current text-white/85), :145-147 (sr-only state); components/ui/signal/README.md:151-166; grep `<UpstreamBreak` = 11 consumers
verify: Write tests/golden-path/upstream-break-contrast.probe.spec.ts first: stripComments(UpstreamBreak.tsx); assert the idle-name class alpha gives >= 4.5:1 and the not-started ring alpha >= 3:1 over #080a10, and idle alpha < current (/85). Red on HEAD (3.14, 1.77). Photograph a studio step blocked upstream (cx-capture studio-*).

lens_checked.visual-craft: Read README.md and all 12 files in full; computed composited contrast on #080a10 for every alpha in the vocabulary: Ghost outline 0.45x0.55=0.25 (2.12:1, documented and accepted as a placeholder), Ghost glyph /25, PipRow hollow/capacity -> finding, StackBar legend /55 (6.26) + neutral fill /20, BandTrack -> finding, UpstreamBreak -> finding, Tally/Provenance keys -> finding, Keycaps kbd /85 + does /60 (7.30), TabRail IDLE /50 (5.33) and LOCKED /30 (disabled - exempt), Hint glyph tones (cyan /75, amber /80, rose /80; 'inherit' = opacity-55 x parent: 2.12:1 under a white/45 parent, 4.78:1 under /85 - 24 of 45 Hint sites use inherit; parent-dependent, not emitted). No colour literals (HATCH paints currentColor).
lens_checked.ux-reviewer: Hint open/close state machine (hover/focus/click/Escape/blur/outside pointerdown) -> finding via a Chromium event-order run; TabRail roving tabindex, manual activation, Home/End, locked tab reachable via aria-disabled; UpstreamBreak action Link vs Button; Keycaps behind Hint
lens_checked.state-coverage: Provenance with no fields returns null (stated reason); Ghost default label 'Nothing here yet'; StackBar total 0 draws an empty rail + zero-count list; BandTrack without band vs hatched vs measured are distinct in aria-label; PipRow generated label when caller supplies none; UpstreamBreak info vs error distinct (role status vs alert, ring vs triangle, detail verbatim)
lens_checked.copy-auditor: DEFAULT_LABEL names, PipRow describe() verbs, UpstreamBreak sr states ('missing', 'you are here', 'done', 'not started'), BandTrack stand-in phrase, StaleBadge 'Why: <words>'. Comment/spec drift noted, not emitted (not rendered): Ghost.tsx:25 and README.md:144 say the outline is '40% opacity' while Ghost.tsx:74 is opacity-55 (its own comment at :64-73 records the change); context-map lists Tally.tsx twice in this context's file_paths (dup-in-one, an app-side ingest bug per CLAUDE.md; no bridge route repairs it).
lens_checked.accessibility-checker: Hint aria-describedby always resolves (sr-only when closed) and has default aria-labels; Hint's Escape stopPropagation does not shield a document-level Modal listener (filed under ui-shell, since Modal.tsx owns the fix); Tally numerals aria-hidden + sr sentence; PipRow/BandTrack role=img with one name; StackBar ul with aria-label; TabRail tablist/tab/aria-selected/aria-controls, aria-describedby only when a reason exists; UpstreamBreak aria-current=step; visible-text contrast -> 2 findings

lens_no_surface.mobile-specialist: no narrow-specific surface; the touch path is covered by the Hint finding
